biggest_catch: Hourly pay means a 12-hour Election Day at $16/hr is ~$192 — long day, modest total, and assignment hours are not guaranteed.
catches: Election-period only work, not steady employment; 'All days and hours are not guaranteed'.
Long Election Day: VSPC 6:30 a.m. to ~9:00 p.m. (~14.5 hours); Election Night ballot security runs 7:30 a.m.-11:00 p.m.
Online training plus in-person training required; must reapply every year.
Bipartisan representation required; must pass county background check; checks mailed with ~two-week delay.
2-hour minimum per position; must work every shift of your assignment.

steps: Submit the online Election Judge application to Arapahoe County (reapply each year).
Pass the county background check required by law.
Complete required online training plus in-person training (paid hours).
Work your assigned shifts, including Election Day (e.g., VSPC 6:30 a.m.-~9:00 p.m. or Driveup Tent 7:00 a.m.-7:00 p.m.).
